# Repository Instructions

Read and follow `AGENTS.md` and `.squad/governance.md` before implementation.
Use the canonical Squad team, decisions, routing, backlog and ownership logs
in every Copilot app child session. Resolve `TEAM_ROOT` to the current checkout,
not the main checkout; parent reconciliation is explicit, not live shared state.

Squad is development coordination only; runtime extraction/generation remains
deterministic with no autonomous agents. Read live issue acceptance criteria,
including OAuth/PKCE, atomic quotas and temporary-retention additions.

Work only on assigned, prerequisite-ready issues with explicit file ownership.
No unattended GitHub writes, PR creation/merge, watchers, deployment or paid
services are enabled by this integration. #43-48 remain post-V1.
